issues.title: Missing failure-mode and retry design for webhook delivery
issues.message: Finding: The plan delivers webhooks with a synchronous POST and treats any 2xx as success, but defines no behavior for timeouts, 5xx, or an unreachable endpoint. Evidence: design-plan.md 'Delivery' section. Impact: Without retry/backoff, idempotency, and ordering decisions, deliveries are silently lost and consumers cannot rely on them. Fix: Specify a retry policy (backoff, max attempts), idempotency keys, and a dead-letter path; consider async delivery so the event path is not blocked. Severity: major Confidence: high
evidence: design-plan.md Delivery: synchronous HTTP POST; 2xx = success only
review-points.md: 失敗モード / リトライ = 未記載
issues.suggestion: Document retry/backoff, max attempts, idempotency, ordering, and a dead-letter strategy; evaluate async delivery.

issues.title: No payload versioning or backward-compatibility plan
issues.message: Finding: The webhook payload has no version field and the plan states no policy for evolving it. Evidence: design-plan.md 'Payload (initial)'. Impact: Any future field change risks breaking existing receivers, since consumers parse an unversioned shape. Fix: Add a version indicator (payload field or header) and a documented compatibility policy (additive changes only within a version). Severity: major Confidence: high
evidence: design-plan.md Payload (initial): { event, id } with no version
review-points.md: 後方互換 / バージョニング = 未記載
issues.suggestion: Introduce a payload/header version and a backward-compatibility policy before shipping the first version.

issues.title: No observability plan for delivery health
issues.message: Finding: The plan does not describe how delivery success rate, latency, or failures will be measured or alerted on. Evidence: design-plan.md has no observability section. Impact: Operators cannot detect or diagnose delivery degradation. Fix: Define metrics (success rate, latency, retry count) and alert thresholds as part of the design. Severity: minor Confidence: medium
evidence: review-points.md: 可観測性 = 未記載
issues.suggestion: Add an observability section: delivery metrics, dashboards, and alert thresholds.
